title: xanthoxalis europaea f. cymosa
intro: Xanthoxalis europaea f. cymosa, commonly known as European wood sorrel, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Oxalidaceae. It has been used for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Xanthoxalis europaea f. cymosa include astringency, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which can help to soothe and protect mucous membranes, reduce swelling, and stimulate urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oxalic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
